tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The window behind every panel. Neutrals are tinted toward the brand purple (OKLCH hue 292), so the black reads warm, not dead grey. Light: a soft tinted grey, so white panels lift off it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels: sidebar, editor, terminal panes. The brand's Black, tinted.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Pane headers, cards, menus and the active row on `surface`.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Icon tiles, inputs, unselected chips and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: control-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of anything on `control`.

tokens.name: control-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state, and the selected secondary row. One step up the same ramp as `control` → `control-hover`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: the pane footer rule, panel borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outlined round buttons, count rings, the dot matrix and diagonal lines.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface and on `purple`. 17:1 on `surface` (APCA Lc 102).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: tab names, paths, captions. 8.9:1 on `surface`, APCA Lc 60 on every neutral up to `control` (was #9a9a9a at Lc 47, too faint). Light: 6.7:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Idle marks, disabled icons, placeholders, line numbers. 4.7:1 on `surface` (APCA Lc 34): marks, not sentences.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on an `ink` fill: the selected pill. Light in dark mode, dark in light mode.

tokens.name: ink-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `purple` and the brand gradient, in both themes: the primary button, the project tile.

tokens.name: ink-on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on `yellow` and `orange` fills, in both themes: a tab that needs you, attention chips.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: The brand colour: primary buttons, the focused pane ring, the working state. Fill only; `ink` on it is 5.9:1.

tokens.name: purple-text
tokens.usage: Purple as text or a thin mark on dark grounds: 8.5:1 on `surface` (APCA Lc 58), where `purple` itself is too dark. Light: 7.4:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: purple-deep
tokens.usage: Third stop of the brand gradient; never on its own.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: First stop of the brand gradient, and the 'your turn' state: an agent finished and waits for your next prompt.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Needs you now: a permission prompt or a question. The loudest colour in Saturn; nothing else uses it.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: An agent stopped on an error (rate limit, crash). Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: status-working
tokens.usage: Working: Claude is thinking or running tools.

tokens.name: status-needs-you
tokens.usage: Needs you: a permission prompt or a question is open. Light mode uses amber (5:1 on `surface`): the brand yellow is invisible on white except as a fill.

tokens.name: status-your-turn
tokens.usage: Your turn: the turn finished; Claude waits for a prompt. Light mode darkens the orange to 4.8:1 for text.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Error: the turn failed.

tokens.name: status-idle
tokens.usage: Idle: a plain shell, or Claude ready with no turn started.

tokens.name: term-black
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI black; matches `surface`. Light: dark, as programs that print black text expect.

tokens.name: term-red
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI red.

tokens.name: term-green
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI green (diff additions, passing tests).

tokens.name: term-yellow
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI yellow.

tokens.name: term-blue
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI blue.

tokens.name: term-magenta
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI magenta; the brand purple lifted for text, same as `purple-text`.

tokens.name: term-cyan
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI cyan.

tokens.name: term-white
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI white and default foreground. Light: the default foreground, dark grey; programs that print white get it too.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Onboarding and the empty window only. Light and tight, as in the brand's headings; one word may take `sat-gradient-text`.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section titles in settings; the project name in a wide sidebar.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Card titles, the project name in the sidebar header.

styles.name: pane-title
styles.usage: Terminal tab and pane names, editor tab names.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default interface text: tree rows, menus, settings.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Pills, chips, buttons. 600, never 500: weights in Saturn are 300, 400 and 600 only, so neighbours always differ by 200 or more.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels above lists, in `ink-muted`. Uppercase always gets the extra tracking.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary lines: branch names, paths, timestamps, in `ink-muted`. Numbers tabular.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Padding between a `radius-lg` card and its `radius-md` children (14 − 4 = 10); gap inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Pane and panel padding where children touch the edge (radius-xl 20 − 6 = radius-lg 14): pane headers, sidebar rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between panels on `ground` and between grid cells; gap between pills.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inner padding of text inside panels; terminal body padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sidebar and card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between groups inside a dialog or empty state.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between sections in settings and onboarding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state breathing room around the headline.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: `kbd` keys and anything 4px inside a `radius-md` element (10 − 4).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Icon tiles, inputs, the editor's inline widgets: anything 4px inside a `radius-lg` card (14 − 4).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tabs, tree rows and anything 6px inside a pane or panel (20 − 6). A 28px tab with it is a pill.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Panels and terminal panes: the brand's soft squircle. Pad 6px for `radius-lg` children.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the onboarding card. Pad 14px for `radius-lg` cards inside, 18px for `radius-md` inputs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, segmented pills, count badges, round icon buttons. A pill inside a pill stays a pill.

radius.note: Nested corners: inner radius = outer radius - padding. Every pairing in the README's table lands on a token; when one doesn't, change the padding, never the radius.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs and the quick-open palette above the grid.

tokens.name: glow-focus
tokens.usage: The focused pane: one at a time.

tokens.name: glow-needs-you
tokens.usage: A pane that needs you and has not been looked at since. Wins over `glow-focus`.

tokens.name: glow-your-turn
tokens.usage: A pane whose turn finished and has not been looked at since.
